{{Quote|Your son was beloved by all the nobles of Doan.|Serra, to the King of Doan, on Gerran|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>}}
'''Gerran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] who lived during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]]. Sometime after [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], he contracted [[Idolian fever]], from which he was cured by the healer [[Serra]]. Gerran fell in love with Serra and the two married, albeit against [[Gerran's father|his father's]] wishes. However, around that [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Doan Royal House|Doan Royal Family]] came into conflict with the planet's [[mining caste]], and in [[980 BBY]] the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] destroyed Gerran's [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] while attempting to capture the prince, accidentally [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I swore an oath to serve the Crown when I married Gerran. Even though he is gone, I would not dishonor his memory by abandoning my duties.|Serra, after Gerran's death|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Gerran was born into the [[Doan Royal House|Royal Family of Doan]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Sith Wars]]. He became the [[Prince/Legends|prince]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]], and sometime after the end of the war in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] Gerran contracted a mysterious illness. [[Gerran's father|His father]] hired the healer [[Serra]] to cure him, and she instantly recognized Gerran's symptoms, diagnosing him with [[Idolian fever]]. Serra nursed the prince back to health over the course of the next three months, and Gerran began to fall in love with her. When at last he was completely cured, Gerran proposed [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] to Serra, who accepted on the condition that her loyal friend and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], would be allowed to remain at her side.

Gerran's father initially disapproved of the marriage, and his efforts to discover anything about Serra's past were unsuccessful due to the actions of Serra's father, [[Caleb]]. Caleb was a healer who had refused to take sides during the New Sith Wars, but after a [[Darth Bane/Legends|Sith Lord]] threatened to kill Serra if Caleb didn't heal him, Caleb forced his daughter to change her name and move offworld so that she couldn't be tracked down and used as leverage again. Serra kept her past a secret, even from Gerran, although he accepted that her past was unimportant. Eventually, Gerran's father reluctantly consented to Serra's request, allowing Gerran to marry her and permitting Lucia to became a member of the [[Doan Royal Guard]].

Around that time, however, the Royal House came into conflict with the planet's lower-class [[mining caste]], and the [[Miner/Legends|miners]] began to rise up against the powerful Royal Family. In [[980 BBY]], [[Gelba]], the leader of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] caste, ordered that Gerran's [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] be forced into an emergency landing in an attempt to capture the prince. During the attack, however, the airspeeder was accidentally destroyed and Gerran was [[Death/Legends|killed]].

After Gerran's death, Serra became very depressed, so Lucia decided to hire the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] known as [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Massacre on Doan|assassinate]] Gelba in retaliation. However, a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], [[Medd Tandar]], was also killed during Gelba's assassination. Serra believed that Gerran would have wanted her to ensure the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] knew that the Royal Family had not been behind Tandar's death, so she traveled to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to do so.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My past is of no consequence, Sire. Your son accepted that.|Serra, to Gerran's father|<ref name="Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil" />}}
Gerran was very popular among the [[Noble/Legends|nobility]] of Doan. He saw several valuable qualities in Serra, and the two deeply loved each other. Although his father's efforts to learn anything about Serra's past turned up no information, Gerran accepted that Serra's past was unimportant. After Gerran's death and the assassination of Gelba, Serra traveled to the Jedi Temple to ensure the Jedi knew that the death of Medd Tandar was not the intention of the Royal Family, as she believed that Gerran would have wanted her to do so.

==Behind the scenes==
Gerran was mentioned in the final novel of the [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']], ''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] and released [[December 8]], [[2009]].
